guards.guard: og-2: the vowel-only cells collide BY DESIGN; ambiguous_template on a bare form-I skeleton is the honest verdict and must never be repaired into a default active reading
voice is never inferred from meaning, from an absent agent, or from a nominative patient inside this unit; those are syntactic evidence handled elsewhere
the lexically stored active imperfect vowel is unrecoverable from a passive surface and is never reported from one
og-4: this unit classifies the verb's voice only; the promoted argument's case and the agreement that follows are not emitted here
final-weak, doubly weak and geminate stems have no rows; no_template records the gap honestly rather than borrowing a sound-stem melody
method transfers, conclusions do not: a decidable medial-weak cell never licenses a voice claim on a sound-stem cell of the same root
